concepts.label: Identifiers (SQL++ expression grammar)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - expression-grammar concept, this page's own topic; not a statement

notable_absence.finding: Unlike the statement/clause pages in this same batch (LET, INFER, INSERT, JOIN), Identifiers carries no Prerequisites/RBAC section at all. As a pure expression-grammar reference describing identifier syntax (unescaped, escaped, aliasing rules), it sits below the level at which Capella's credential-type-keyed privilege model attaches - that model gates statements/clauses that touch keyspace data, not grammar-level building blocks used inside them.
